filer_type_check: quarterly_report_only (11 Appendix 5B quarterlies in 3 years, no 4D/4E). The 2026-09-28 date is not a 5B, since the September-quarter 5B is due late October. It matches the Annual Report to shareholders, which VMM lodged after the close on 24 Sep 2025 (18:09) and 20 Sep 2024 (18:22) and has not yet lodged for FY26 as of the 24 Sep 2026 archive row. So I checked whether a statutory annual report can carry anything new for a developer: cash, going-concern and the Colossus funding path.
event_check: The event is real, but only the deadline is confirmed, not the day. The FY26 Annual Report is due by 30 Sep 2026 (a 30 June year end plus three months). The 2026 ASX archive (https://www.asx.com.au/asx/v2/statistics/announcements.do?by=asxCode&asxCode=VMM&timeframe=Y&year=2026) shows no annual report through the 24 Sep Goldman Sachs presentation, and I found no dated 'Notice of results'. The 2025 archive (https://www.asx.com.au/asx/v2/statistics/announcements.do?by=asxCode&asxCode=VMM&timeframe=Y&year=2025) shows the prior one on 24/09/2025 at 6:09 pm, and the 2024 archive shows 20/09/2024 at 6:22 pm. So it lands on 28, 29 or 30 Sep, and only a 28 Sep lodgement falls inside the window. That uncertainty matters little because the expected size is zero either way.
session_check: amc. Both prior annual reports were lodged after 18:00 Sydney (2025-09-24 18:09, 2024-09-20 18:22) per the ASX archive https://www.asx.com.au/asx/v2/statistics/announcements.do?by=asxCode&asxCode=VMM&timeframe=Y&year=2025, which is consistent with the baseline's amc.

outside_window.finding: OneIM Tranche 2 (~A$44.8M at A$3.79) still needs FIRB and shareholder approval. The AGM is set for 4 Nov 2026, with its notice due in early October, so approval or a FIRB delay lands after the window. With spot at 3.48, below the A$3.79 placement price, completion would underwrite the price.

The Colossus Installation Licence (LI, lodged with FEAM in May 2026) is pending, and on 27 Aug 2026 the Poços de Caldas municipal chamber asked the state prosecutor (MPMG) to open a civil inquiry into groundwater, radiological and tailings questions. This is a licensing-delay risk with no COPAM vote dated inside the window.
